applicabilityBasis.summary: UTY is a transferable dollar-pegged base token, distinct from the value-accruing yUTY share. Current contracts and flows describe 1:1 minting against USDC and USDC redemption on Base after a seven-day bonding period. Terms identify XSY Foundation doing business as YieldPoint and a geographically permitted UTY redemption right. Payment design is evidenced by live EIP-3009/EIP-2612 support and agent-settlement documentation, but hosted x402 endpoints and the Payable Router are still planned. GENIUS section 2(22) requires an issuer obligation for a fixed amount of monetary value and expressly excludes conversion solely into a digital asset denominated in such value. The reviewed UTY materials establish USDC conversion, not that monetary obligation; applicability is therefore unclear rather than a confirmed payment-stablecoin or non-payment-token exclusion.

genius.notes: Re-verified 2026-10-07. The existing non-payment-token/not-applicable row treated UTY as a yield product with minting unavailable to the general public. Current YieldPoint documentation separates fixed USDC-denominated UTY from yield-bearing yUTY and matches the catalog UTY contract 0xba515304d8153c4b162dc79f867e152df9c127eb on Base, Avalanche and Katana. issuerEntity is newly set to XSY Foundation, the exact legal platform/token-services counterparty in the current Terms of Use. No issuer domicile is inferred from the Cayman arbitration seat. The specific U.S. Person restriction applies to yield-bearing tokens; it is not proof that UTY itself is excluded from U.S. access. Applicability changes conservatively to unclear/no-public-authorization-found because fixed USDC exchange and payment design do not establish the statutory monetary-value redemption obligation. The researcher's shipped Payable Router and hosted x402 endpoint claims are corrected: those facilities are under development, although token-level authorization standards are documented as live. No monthly independent reserve attestation was located; the Accountable hub/cache supplies public reserve data instead.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or OCC foreign-issuer registration naming XSY Foundation, YieldPoint or UTY was located in the sources checked. The OCC table covers pending digital-asset licensing applications, not an exhaustive GENIUS issuer register. Indexed searches and issuer silence do not establish that no unindexed or nonpublic filing exists. Foreign-exception status remains unknown; no inference of non-compliance is made.
